label: Shopping & Money
description: Buying things, asking prices, paying, and handling money in shops and markets.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: asking a price. This is the core shopping question — стоит means costs and сколько means how much. Use it for any item by pointing and naming it, and listen for the number of рублей in the reply.

missions.phrase: У вас есть этот размер побольше?
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: asking about sizes. The word размер covers clothing and shoe sizes, and побольше softly asks for a bigger one. This phrase lets you check stock politely before deciding to buy.
Strategic focus: trying things on. The verb примерить means to try on and is essential in any clothing store. Pair it with можно to make a natural, polite request to the assistant.
Strategic focus: deciding to buy. Возьму literally means I will take and is the standard way Russians say I'll take it. Add вот это while pointing to make your choice unmistakable at the counter.
Strategic focus: paying by card. The verb оплатить means to pay for and карта is a bank card. Asking this first avoids surprises when a small shop or market stall only takes наличные.
Strategic focus: paying with cash. Наличные means cash and is useful at markets where cards are not accepted. The word только signals you have no other option, prompting the seller to adjust.

Strategic focus: checking your change. Сдача is the change handed back after paying, and неправильную flags that it is wrong. Knowing this phrase protects you when counting coins quickly at the касса.
Strategic focus: asking about discounts. The word скидка means discount or sale, common on tags and store windows. Asking directly can save money, especially on seasonal items like туфли.

Strategic focus: reacting to a price. Дорого means expensive and слишком means too. This line politely signals that something is out of budget and often opens room to negotiate or look for cheaper options.
Strategic focus: getting a receipt. The word чек means receipt and is needed for returns or expense records. The imperative дайте plus пожалуйста makes a short, polite request after paying.
